Extract all value slots in an R6 object

Source: R/AnalysisConfiguration.R
R6_extract_values.Rd

Extract all value slots in an R6 object

Usage

R6_extract_values(r6class)

Arguments

r6class

r6 class

Value

The computed result.

See also

Other configuration: AnalysisConfiguration, ContrastConfiguration, INTERNAL_FUNCTIONS_BY_FAMILY, complete_cases(), make_interaction_column(), make_reduced_hierarchy_config(), sample_subset(), separate_hierarchy(), setup_analysis(), table_factors(), table_factors_size()

Examples

bb <- sim_lfq_data_peptide_config()
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> completing cases
#> completing cases done
#> setup done
values <- R6_extract_values(bb$config)
names(values)
#>  [1] "min_peptides_protein"    "hierarchy_depth"        
#>  [3] "hierarchy"               "factor_depth"           
#>  [5] "factors"                 "bin_resp"               
#>  [7] "is_response_transformed" "work_intensity"         
#>  [9] "nr_children"             "opt_se"                 
#> [11] "opt_mz"                  "opt_rt"                 
#> [13] "ident_score"             "ident_q_value"          
#> [15] "isotope_label"           "sample_name"            
#> [17] "file_name"               "sep"
